fact_types.title: Total ordinary dividends reported in box 1a of one logical Form 1099-DIV statement instance furnished by a payer for 2025; the statement instance is peer to evidence and its identity carries no file, upload, scan, document, or evidence key (ADR-0015, instantiated per ADR-0035 decision 1). Multiple originals from one payer - including several concerning one account - are distinct statement instances; a corrected copy of the same logical return answers this same fact and supersedes its prior finding.

Qualified dividends reported in box 1b of one logical Form 1099-DIV statement instance furnished by a payer for 2025, keyed to the same statement identity as box 1a (ADR-0035 decision 2). Box 1b is by definition a subset of box 1a on the same statement; the per-statement invariant 1b <= 1a is enforced at tax-layer admission (ADR-0035 decision 4), never by this value schema, which Draft 2020-12 cannot express cross-field.

User-attested closure of the Form 1099-DIV box-1a source family for 2025, keyed on the family membership horizon current at attestation (ADR-0017): true asserts every furnished 1099-DIV box-1a statement item is recorded as of that horizon. This claim covers box 1a only - never box 1b, the recorded non-composable boxes, or Form 1040 line 3b (ADR-0016, ADR-0035 decision 2). A later membership transition displaces this closure through horizon succession; re-attestation on the successor horizon is required.

User-attested closure of the Form 1099-DIV box-1b source family for 2025, keyed on the family membership horizon current at attestation (ADR-0017): true asserts every furnished 1099-DIV box-1b statement item is recorded as of that horizon. This claim covers box 1b only - never box 1a, the recorded non-composable boxes, or Form 1040 line 3a (ADR-0016, ADR-0035 decision 2); the two per-box families close independently and their lines may block independently. A later membership transition displaces this closure through horizon succession; re-attestation on the successor horizon is required.

label: Form 1099-DIV composable boxes 1a/1b vocabulary for tax year 2025 without residual recorded-boxes (ADR-0050 exclusive successor graph)
